## Implemented Behavior

- The new route is inside the existing authenticated, active-user, administrator middleware group.
- The page lists all sessions in descending session-date order, including unpublished drafts.
- Each row shows the title, category, date, publication status, and protected-resource count.
- Each row links to the existing session view, where administrator access to unpublished sessions is already enforced server-side.
- Non-administrators receive a forbidden response for the new admin route.
- The existing participant Classroom link still points to the dashboard classroom section.
